title: Potential mechanisms and material basis of Jinhua Qinggan Granules against Zika virus infection and associated inflammatory responses.
authors: Shafqat, Amna; Shafqat, Muhammad Burhan; Zakirullah; Xu, Shan; Tong, Yigang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金花清感颗粒中绿原酸抗寨卡病毒及抗炎机制，涉及分子对接与MD模拟但对象为病毒NS3蛋白酶，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Jinhua Qinggan Granules (JHQG) is a traditional Chinese medicine formulation widely used for the treatment of viral respiratory infections. Traditional herbal formulations contain multiple phytochemical constituents that may act individually or synergistically to produce therapeutic effects. Although its clinical applications have been reported, the bioactive constituents underlying its antiviral activity and their mechanisms of action remain to be clarified. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to identify representative bioactive constituents of JHQG with antiviral activity against Zika virus (ZIKV) and to investigate their potential mechanisms of action. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A panel of representative phytochemical constituents reported in JHQG was screened for antiviral activity against ZIKV in vitro. Antiviral efficacy and cytotoxicity were evaluated by determining EC(50) and CC(50) values. Viral replication was assessed using plaque assay, RT-qPCR, immunofluorescence, and Western blot analysis. Time-of-addition experiments were performed to explore stage-specific effects. Transcriptome analysis and quantitative PCR were conducted to examine host inflammatory gene expression. Intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels and NF-kappaB activation were evaluated in stimulated cells. In vivo antiviral efficacy was assessed in a ZIKV infection model using A129 mice. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to explore potential interactions with the viral NS3 protease. RESULTS: Among the screened compounds, chlorogenic acid (CGA) exhibited notable antiviral activity and was selected for further investigation. CGA treatment was associated with reduced ZIKV replication, decreased viral protein expression, and lower production of infectious viral particles under the tested conditions. Time-of-addition experiments indicated that CGA exerted inhibitory effects during early stages and throughout the infection period. ZIKV infection induced the expression of inflammatory genes including CXCL8, CXCL10, and TNFAIP3, whereas treatment with JHQG or CGA was associated with reduced expression of these genes. CGA treatment also corresponded with decreased intracellular ROS levels and attenuation of NF-kappaB activation. In A129 mice, CGA administration was associated with improved survival, reduced viral RNA levels in brain and liver tissues, and partial preservation of tissue morphology. Computational analyses suggested potential interactions between CGA and the NS3 protease. CONCLUSION: These findings identify CGA as a representative bioactive constituent selected from the screened phytochemical components of JHQG that may contribute to its antiviral activity. The antiviral effects observed in this study, together with the modulation of host inflammatory responses, provide experimental evidence supporting further investigation of CGA as a candidate compound for the development of therapeutic strategies against ZIKV infection.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：金花清感颗粒（JHQG）是一种广泛用于治疗病毒性呼吸道感染的传统中药制剂。传统草药配方含有多种植物化学成分，这些成分可能单独或协同作用以产生治疗效果。尽管其临床应用已有报道，但其抗病毒活性背后的生物活性成分及其作用机制仍有待阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在鉴定JHQG中具有抗寨卡病毒（ZIKV）活性的代表性生物活性成分，并探讨其潜在作用机制。材料与方法：对JHQG中报道的一组代表性植物化学成分进行了体外抗ZIKV活性筛选。通过测定EC(50)和CC(50)值评估抗病毒效力和细胞毒性。使用空斑实验、RT-qPCR、免疫荧光和Western blot分析评估病毒复制。进行了时间添加实验以探索阶段特异性效应。进行了转录组分析和定量PCR以检查宿主炎症基因表达。在刺激细胞中评估了细胞内活性氧（ROS）水平和NF-kappaB激活。使用A129小鼠在ZIKV感染模型中评估了体内抗病毒效力。进行了分子对接和分子动力学模拟以探索与病毒NS3蛋白酶的可能相互作用。结果：在筛选的化合物中，绿原酸（CGA）表现出显著的抗病毒活性，并被选作进一步研究。在测试条件下，CGA处理与ZIKV复制减少、病毒蛋白表达降低以及感染性病毒颗粒产生减少相关。时间添加实验表明，CGA在早期阶段和整个感染期间均发挥抑制作用。ZIKV感染诱导了包括CXCL8、CXCL10和TNFAIP3在内的炎症基因表达，而JHQG或CGA处理与这些基因表达降低相关。CGA处理还对应细胞内ROS水平降低和NF-kappaB激活减弱。在A129小鼠中，CGA给药与生存率提高、脑和肝组织中病毒RNA水平降低以及组织形态部分保留相关。计算分析提示CGA与NS3蛋白酶之间存在潜在相互作用。结论：这些发现将CGA鉴定为从JHQG筛选的植物化学成分中选出的代表性生物活性成分，可能有助于其抗病毒活性。本研究中观察到的抗病毒效应，连同宿主炎症反应的调节，为支持进一步研究CGA作为针对ZIKV感染治疗策略开发的候选化合物提供了实验证据。
